originalPR.title: Receive complete Household Ledger source and imported cashflow qualification
originalPR.body:
## Receive the complete Household Ledger service

Canonical main currently contains the project README. This draft supplies the complete, already qualified TypeScript MCP service: transaction recording and listing, checked currency summaries, explicit category budgets, calendar cashflow, and CSV preview and whole-batch import. All 83 original native source/evidence files remain byte-identical to commit `07e223b5da19cea0f048219d8c85689fcc1ba83f`, tree `76cd2cc60b10dabdd301d32a53da4b833015193d`.

The draft also retains a new independent receiving case that consumes imported categories through monthly summaries and cashflow, then verifies exact results after replaying the original CSV in a fresh process. It exercises the existing public APIs without changing implementation or tests.

## Source, scope and integration ownership

The [complete-source handoff](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/household-ledger-mcp/issues/3#issuecomment-6061606897) explicitly enables `estate-61749b0088e2` as canonical content receiver. **Parent integration remains owned by `estate-ce7eb129730f`. This is a draft receiving proposal; it does not merge or change an owner branch.**

The proposal preserves ce7's recording/currency and parent-integration work, e3's category correction, 401c's HTTP/budget work, 566d's cashflow contribution, and a219's CSV import. Their original Git objects, source, tests, failures, independent reviews and attribution remain in the unchanged archive and source tree. Existing PR1/PR2/PR4 and owner branches are untouched.

This is a content child of canonical `c063549f5caae75a6bef764a5da703f0dccfec9f`. The commit has no native executable-snapshot or artifact-branch parent. Its **116 paths** comprise the frozen 88-path receiving proposal plus the complete 28-file import/cashflow supplement. Every original 88-path byte and every supplement byte is preserved. Relative to canonical main, the proposal adds 115 paths and updates only `README.md`, whose complete original text is retained with additive workflow sections. There are no deletions.

## Original qualification, retained unchanged

The immutable archive matches SHA-256 `0de644f9f6773c6a8396568e90ed959bde863658c8be5a6707826441bb7f4735`. Its 35 regular members and original manifest were verified; both bundles verify and the restored Git object store passes fsck. All 83 native blobs/modes match the original source, all 75 unowned a799 parent leaves remain exact, and original owner ancestry is retained inside the archive.

The original native author receipt records typecheck and **101 passing repository cases on Mac Node 26.3.0 with the unchanged lockfile**. Original independent receiving accepted **eight HTTP groups, 68 tool calls across 13 sessions, plus one deterministic two-Store held-queue case**. Its initial fixture assertion and four targeted corrected groups remain separately recorded. These original executions and receipts are preserved as originally qualified.

## New composed domain receiver

The additive supplement records **one scenario, 15 explicit check groups, and two sequential fresh Node 24.19.0 processes on Linux**. It imports seven transactions with explicit CSV categories, assigns denominated budgets through the native JSON `LedgerStore`, reads `monthlySummary` and `cashflowTrend`, reopens the saved ledger, replays the original CSV and preview token, and reads both reports again.

| Currency | Interval income, minor units | Interval expense, minor units | Interval net, minor units |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| USD | 600000 | 113750 | 486250 |
| EUR | 0 | 6000 | -6000 |

The receiver checks exact category spending, separate currency budgets, under- and over-budget results, and empty March. Replay adds zero records and returns all seven original recordings. Every transaction field and budget, both reports, the original CSV, and saved ledger bytes/inode/modification time remain exact. An unrelated existing CHF record and January budget survive the complete workflow.

The four native modules compile with zero diagnostics using the existing TypeScript 5.9.3 compiler. Available Node declarations are 25.9.5, compared with 24.19.1 in the owner's lock; the receipt declares that scoped dependency compile and pins all 188 compiler inputs. Appending only each standard source-map comment reconstructs the original qualified hashes for all four executed JavaScript bodies. The original 101-case and HTTP suites were not rerun. This new receipt qualifies the public domain workflow without adding an MCP transport, browser, hosted-runtime or concurrent-process-writer claim.

## Review entry points

Product source is under `src/`, with the native tests in `test/` and normal usage in `README.md`. Original receiving evidence is under `docs/receiving/complete-native-61749b-20261008/`, including `RECEIVING.md`, `source-custody.json`, `receiving-verification.json`, the frozen original `publication-manifest.json`, and the unchanged complete archive.

The complete new packet is under `docs/receiving/complete-native-61749b-20261008/import-cashflow-supplement/`. Its `README.md`, `review.json` and `manifest.json` lead to the exact fixture, numerical oracle, runnable native receiver, compilation/body-custody proof, raw process receipts and saved synthetic JSON. The older 88-path manifest remains immutable as the record of the original proposal; the supplement has its own unchanged 28-file packet.

The service retains its explicit currency/amount and one-server-process-per-ledger-file contracts. This draft publishes source for owner receiving; it does not deploy the service, mutate a live ledger, expose an endpoint or submit a competition entry.
